display.name: Microsoft Agent Framework
display.description: Agent runs, LLM calls, token usage, tools, workflows and errors for applications built on Microsoft Agent Framework (Python), using its built-in OpenTelemetry instrumentation. Built on traces: token panels read chat spans only, because invoke_agent spans repeat the same totals.

display.name: Service
display.description: Service running Microsoft Agent Framework.

display.name: Environment
display.description: Deployment environment.

display.name: Agent Runs
display.description: Agent invocations (invoke_agent spans). Agents run inside workflows count once each, so a three-agent workflow adds three.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent'

display.name: LLM Calls
display.description: Model calls across all agents (chat spans).

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'chat'

display.name: Input Tokens
display.description: Prompt tokens, summed over chat spans only. invoke_agent spans repeat the same totals, so summing every span would double the figure.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'chat'

display.name: Output Tokens
display.description: Completion tokens over chat spans, including reasoning tokens.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'chat'

display.name: Workflow Runs
display.description: Sequential, concurrent, handoff and custom workflow executions (workflow.run spans).

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND name = 'workflow.run'

display.name: Agent Error Rate
display.description: Share of agent invocations that ended in error. Tool failures do not count here: the agent recovers and its span stays unset. See Tool Error Rate.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent' AND has_error = true
service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent'

display.name: Token Usage Over Time
display.description: Input, output, reasoning and cache-read tokens over time, from chat spans.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'chat'
service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'chat'
service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'chat'
service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'chat'

display.name: Tokens by Model
display.description: Calls and tokens per served model. Groups on gen_ai.response.model, which carries the dated snapshot (e.g. gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18) where the provider returns one.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'chat' AND gen_ai.response.model EXISTS

display.name: LLM Calls by Model
display.description: Chat call volume per served model.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'chat' AND gen_ai.response.model EXISTS

display.name: Tokens by Agent
display.description: Token totals per agent, read from invoke_agent spans, which roll up their chat calls. Safe here because it never mixes with chat spans.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent' AND gen_ai.agent.name EXISTS

display.name: LLM Call Latency
display.description: p50 / p95 / p99 duration of chat spans.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'chat'

display.name: Agent Latency (p95)
display.description: p95 end-to-end duration per agent, including its model and tool calls.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent' AND gen_ai.agent.name EXISTS

display.name: Workflow Latency (p95)
display.description: p95 duration per workflow, from workflow.run spans.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND name = 'workflow.run' AND workflow.name EXISTS

display.name: Finish Reasons
display.description: Why each model call ended. A high tool_calls share means agents are looping through tools; length means responses are being truncated.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'chat' AND gen_ai.response.finish_reasons EXISTS

display.name: Agents
display.description: Runs, errors and average latency per agent.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent' AND gen_ai.agent.name EXISTS

display.name: Tools
display.description: Calls, failures and average latency per tool.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'execute_tool' AND gen_ai.tool.name EXISTS

display.name: Tool Calls Over Time
display.description: Tool invocations per tool. A sustained climb is the usual early sign of an agent loop that is not terminating.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'execute_tool' AND gen_ai.tool.name EXISTS

display.name: Workflows
display.description: Runs and average duration per workflow. Token cost of a workflow is the sum of its agents in Tokens by Agent; workflow spans carry no token counts themselves.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND name = 'workflow.run' AND workflow.name EXISTS

display.name: Workflow Executors
display.description: Executor steps inside workflows: agents plus built-in steps such as dispatcher and aggregator. Slow built-in steps point at orchestration overhead.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND name LIKE 'executor.process%' AND executor.id EXISTS

display.name: Tool Error Rate
display.description: Share of tool executions that raised. The agent usually recovers and answers, so these failures are invisible at the agent level.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'execute_tool' AND has_error = true
service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'execute_tool'

display.name: LLM Error Rate
display.description: Share of model calls that failed (bad model, auth, rate limit, timeout). These also fail the parent agent span.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'chat' AND has_error = true
service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'chat'

display.name: Errors by Type
display.description: Errored spans by error.type and operation. An LLM failure appears twice, on the chat span and its invoke_agent parent, so read per operation rather than summing.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND has_error = true AND error.type EXISTS

display.name: Recent Errors
display.description: Latest errored spans with their error class and message.

filter.expression: service.name IN $service_name AND deployment.environment IN $environment AND has_error = true
